units.source_text: 杜子春一见到老人家，惭愧的垂下了头，沉默了片刻。

en.t: As soon as Toshishun saw the old man, he lowered his head in shame and was silent for a while.

units.source_text: 但是，老人这次的问话和上次一样，而且态度亲切，

en.t: But the old man's question this time was the same as before, and his manner was kind,

units.source_text: 于是杜子春也和上次一样，谨慎的回复说：

en.t: So Toshishun, just as he had before, answered cautiously:
